name: agent-tasks
description: Agents report the tasks they're working on to Cloudflare D1; a polling dashboard shows Machine -> Session -> Tasks.

scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run db:migrate:remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && node --test test/session-metadata.test.ts test/session-groups.test.ts test/session-stack-layout.test.ts test/shell-jwt.test.ts test/identity.test.ts test/session-filters.test.ts test/knowledge.test.ts test/store-d1.test.ts test/knowledge-r2.test.ts test/search.test.ts test/events.test.ts test/launch.test.ts test/purge-project.test.ts
